words.sent: It is ___ cheaper than it looks.
words.full: It is actually cheaper than it looks.
words.alt: Actually, I have never been there.
words.cp: actually 用于纠正或补充信息｜in actual fact 事实上｜actual adj. 实际的

words.full: alternatively, you could take the train.
words.alt: Alternatively, we could postpone the meeting.
words.altZh: 或者我们可以推迟会议。
words.cp: alternatively 用于提出另一选择，常置于句首｜alternative n./adj. 替代方案/可替代的

words.full: He apparently knew nothing about it.
words.alt: Apparently, the flight is delayed.
words.cp: apparently 兼表“看来”与“据说”｜apparent adj. 明显的

words.alt: He automatically reached for his phone.
words.cp: automatically 兼指“自动地”与“不假思索地”｜automatic adj. 自动的

words.sent: ___, the two plans are the same.
words.tr: 这两个计划基本上是一样的。
words.full: basically, the two plans are the same.
words.alt: Basically, we need more money.
words.altZh: 从根本上说，我们需要更多钱。
words.cp: basically 用于概括或简化说明，常置于句首｜basic adj. 基本的｜basis n. 基础

words.tr: 他简短地谈了这个计划。
words.full: He spoke briefly about the plan.
words.alt: She was briefly famous.
words.cp: briefly 兼指“简短地”与“短暂地”｜briefly speaking 简言之｜brief adj. 简短的

words.alt: She carefully avoided the subject.
words.altZh: 她小心地避开了这个话题。
words.cp: carefully 修饰动词，表“仔细/小心地”｜careful adj. 仔细的｜careless 为其反义词

words.alt: Certainly, you may borrow it.
words.cp: certainly 表“肯定/当然”，语气强于 probably｜certain adj. 确定的｜Certainly! 单独使用表示“当然可以”

words.alt: Please speak more clearly.
words.cp: clearly 兼表“清楚地”与“显然”｜clearly defined 界定清晰的｜clear adj. 清楚的

words.full: The two events are closely linked.
words.alt: Watch him closely.
words.cp: closely related/linked 密切相关的（高频搭配）｜注意与 close（近地）区别：close 指距离近

words.alt: It is commonly believed that ...
words.cp: commonly held belief 普遍看法｜commonly used 常用的｜common adj. 常见的

words.alt: The house was completely destroyed.
words.cp: completely different 完全不同（高频搭配）｜complete adj. 完整的/彻底的

words.full: She is constantly checking her phone.
words.alt: The situation is constantly changing.
words.cp: constantly changing 不断变化（高频搭配）｜constant adj. 不断的

words.alt: The post is currently vacant.
words.cp: currently 表“目前”，常与进行时连用｜current adj. 当前的｜current n. 水流/电流

words.full: We will definitely finish on time.
words.alt: That is definitely the best choice.
words.cp: definitely 表强烈的肯定，口语中常用｜definite adj. 明确的｜definitely not 绝对不是

words.alt: Effectively, the plan has failed.
words.altZh: 实际上，这个计划已经失败。
words.cp: effectively 兼表“有效地”与“实际上”｜effective adj. 有效的｜注意与 efficiently（高效地）区分

words.full: The two parts are equally important.
words.alt: The money was divided equally.
words.cp: equally important 同样重要（高频搭配）｜equally 用于比较时表“同样地”｜equal adj. 相等的

words.tr: 我喜欢水果，尤其是芒果。
words.alt: The weather was especially hot.
words.cp: especially 用于强调某一特例｜specially 指“专门地”（specially made 特制）｜especial adj. 特别的

words.full: That is exactly what I said.
words.alt: The train left at exactly nine.
words.cp: exactly 表“精确地/正是”｜exactly! 单独使用表示“正是如此”｜exact adj. 精确的

words.alt: The money was fairly divided.
words.cp: fairly 表“相当”（程度弱于 quite、rather）｜fairly 亦表“公平地”｜fair adj. 公平的

words.alt: Finally, I would like to thank you all.
words.cp: finally 兼表“终于”与“最后（列举）”｜final adj. 最后的｜注意与 eventually 近义

words.alt: He firmly closed the door.
words.cp: firmly believe 坚信（高频搭配）｜firmly established 牢固确立的｜firm adj. 坚定的

words.tr: 一般来说，物价在夏季上涨。
words.alt: It is generally accepted that ...
words.cp: generally speaking 一般来说（固定搭配）｜generally accepted 普遍接受的｜general adj. 总的

words.alt: She gradually recovered.
words.cp: gradually 强调渐进过程｜gradual adj. 逐渐的｜反义 suddenly

words.alt: Prices vary greatly.
words.cp: greatly appreciate 非常感激（高频搭配）｜greatly improved 大大改善的｜great adj. 大的

words.alt: Hardly had he left when it rained.
words.cp: hardly 表否定（几乎不）｜hardly ... when 一……就（固定句型，用于句首需倒装）｜hardly any 几乎没有

words.alt: The book is highly recommended.
words.cp: highly + 形容词/过去分词 表“高度地”（highly skilled/recommended）｜high 指具体高度

words.tr: 他接完电话就立刻离开了。
words.full: He left immediately after the call.
words.alt: The house is immediately opposite.
words.cp: immediately 兼表“立即”与“紧接地”｜immediately after 紧接在……之后｜immediate adj. 立即的

words.tr: 工作越来越多地在线上完成。
words.alt: It is becoming increasingly difficult.
words.cp: increasingly + 形容词/副词 表“越来越”｜increase v. 增加｜increasing adj. 不断增加的

words.sent: The delay was ___ due to rain.
words.tr: 延误主要是下雨造成的。
words.full: The delay was largely due to rain.
words.alt: The audience was largely young.
words.cp: largely 表“主要地/在很大程度上”｜large adj. 大的｜注意与 loosely（松散地）拼写区别

words.alt: He merely smiled and said nothing.
words.cp: merely 表“仅仅”，含“不重要”意味｜not merely ... but also 不仅……而且（固定搭配）｜mere adj. 仅仅的

words.alt: Naturally, I was disappointed.
words.cp: naturally 兼表“天生地”“自然地”“当然”｜naturally occurring 天然存在的｜natural adj. 自然的

words.alt: Nearly everyone agreed.
words.cp: not nearly 远非（固定搭配）｜nearly 强调接近程度｜近义 almost

words.alt: Obviously, we cannot accept that.
words.cp: obviously 表“显然”，常置于句首作评注性状语｜obvious adj. 明显的

words.full: I am particularly interested in history.
words.alt: This is particularly true of young people.
words.altZh: 对年轻人来说尤其如此。
words.cp: particularly 用于强调特例，近义 especially｜particular adj. 特定的｜in particular 尤其

words.alt: Could you possibly help me?
words.cp: possibly 表“可能/也许”，可与 may/might 连用｜用于请求时表示礼貌｜possible adj. 可能的

words.full: The train left at precisely nine.
words.alt: Precisely! That is my point.
words.cp: precisely 表“精确地/正是”，语气强于 exactly｜precise adj. 精确的
